# Synthetic baseline source report

This is a handwritten input report, not a generated comparison or real execution
record. It describes the declared baseline choice on `synthetic-review` version
`1`, split `fixed-test`, protocol `synthetic-eval-v1`, seed `7`.

The selected result is [primary metrics](attempts/primary/metrics.json), also
retained as the [local metrics artifact](artifacts/metrics.json). The named metric
is `accuracy`; its unit, range and direction are in the JSON rather than inferred.
The [replay metrics](attempts/replay/metrics.json) declare another observation under
this same Run. The [wrong-cwd log](attempts/wrong-cwd/stderr.log) records the input's
failure scenario and has no numeric result.

Read the [Run recipe](run.yaml), [artifact inventory](artifacts.yaml) and
[human notes](notes.md) for identities, selection and limitations. No uncertainty
or independent repeated-Run statistics are supplied.
